cases.description: Decomposed Latin text is normalized to NFC before lower-casing (step 2): `## Café au lait` gives `café-au-lait`; GitHub gives `café-au-lait`, since it does not normalize to NFC.
Decomposed Latin text is normalized to NFC before lower-casing (step 2): `## Crème brûlée` gives `crème-brûlée`; GitHub gives `crème-brûlée`, since it does not normalize to NFC.

Decomposed Latin text is normalized to NFC before lower-casing (step 2): `## ÀÉÎÕÜ upper` gives `àéîõü-upper`; GitHub gives `àéîõü-upper`, since it does not normalize to NFC.
